sv.title: Svenskan sänkte topplaget Manchester City
sv.summary: Landslagsmittfältaren Matilda Vinberg avgjorde mot topplaget Manchester City i Super League-fotbollen. Vinberg satte 2–1 när Tottenham vann med 3–1 på bortaplan.

en.title: Swede sinks top side Manchester City
en.summary: National team midfielder Matilda Vinberg decided the match against top side Manchester City in Super League football. Vinberg scored 2–1 as Tottenham won 3–1 away.
